task: Make average() return 0.0 for an empty list instead of raising ZeroDivisionError.
Add a function clamp(x, lo, hi) that limits x to the range lo..hi, and keep double() as it is.
Make slugify() lowercase the text and join its words with single hyphens, ignoring extra spaces.
Implement to_roman(n) so it returns the Roman numeral for a whole number from 1 to 3999.
Make dedupe() remove duplicates but keep the first occurrence of each item in its original order.
